items.preview: On 2026-08-24 I shipped a change to the configuration that emits PyPI's download logs so that only requests for actual distribution artifacts are counted. The counts are more accurate now, and existing systems based on PyPI's BigQuery dataset , like pypistats.org will display a different shape going forward.
